what_it_pays_for: You feature a seller's product in a video or live stream and earn a commission on what sells through your link. Earnings track sales rather than views, so a small engaged audience can out-earn a large passive one.

revenue_basis.note: A function of order value, conversion rate and the commission rate the seller sets. None of the three is observable from public account data.

additional_requirements_not_assessed: Availability is limited to certain markets.
Account standing requirements apply, and a follower bar is widely reported but has not been sourced here.

provenance.note: Searched 2026-08-27 without locating an official eligibility article; the seller-side university URL previously recorded here was a guess and did not resolve to a rule page. The follower figure widely reported for the affiliate programme is deliberately NOT recorded, because recording an unsourced number next to sourced ones is exactly what this library exists to prevent.
